note: Activity log rotates on append past a configured bound. New config keys activity_log_max_bytes / activity_log_max_days (both default None = no rotation, junk/zero/negative tolerated as "no bound"). append_log_entry checks the bound against the file on disk and renames to activity-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.jsonl before writing, so the appended entry never vanishes; a failed rename still appends to the live file. Age is measured from the oldest entry's timestamp (mtime fallback), documented. New log_paths(project_dir) returns rotated siblings oldest-first then the live file; pm_activity, /api/activity and migrations.read_activity_log all use it, and "No activity log found" now means neither live nor rotated. 33 new tests; full suite 5402 passed, 18 skipped, 0 failed.
